reader_summary.headline: Today, another episode of Behind the Memo, in which Howard sheds sunlight on themes from his most recent memo.
reader_summary.overview: Today, another episode of Behind the Memo, in which Howard sheds sunlight on themes from his most recent memo. Here he is discussing, I beg to differ with Oak Tree's senior financial writer Anna Shamansky. Howard, in this memo, you weave together a number of themes related to the importance of thinking and acting differently.

key_points.text: Let's start with one of these key concepts, second-level thinking.
